rootQuestionId.description: Id of the first question asked when running this tree (a key into `questions`). Null only when the tree has no questions yet.

questions.description: Every question in this tree, keyed by its own id.

id.description: Unique identifier for this tree. Regenerated whenever a file is imported, so it never collides with a tree already in the library.

name.description: Display name shown on the dashboard card and in the editor/runner header.

description.description: Optional longer description shown under the name on the dashboard and editor.

options.description: The possible final outcomes this tree can resolve to (e.g. "Jupyter Notebook", "Spark Job"). At least 2 are required.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this tree was first created.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent edit. The app updates this automatically on every change.

schemaVersion.description: Data format version. Used to validate (and, in future, migrate) imported files. Currently always 1.

DecisionTree.description:
A decision tree created by the Decision Tree Builder app.

`mode: "sequential"` is a literal branching tree — each answer leads to another question or terminates at one final option. `mode: "weighted"` asks every question and sums per-answer scores toward each final option, with the highest-scoring option(s) winning. Mode is locked once a tree is created.

id.description: Unique id for this question, matching its key in the parent `questions` map.

text.description: The question text shown to the person answering.

choices.description: The answer choices for this question. At least 2 are required.

SequentialQuestion.description: A single question in a sequential tree; its choices lead onward to another question or a final option.

text.description: The answer text shown as a button.

nextQuestionId.description: Id of the question to continue to after picking this answer. Exactly one of `nextQuestionId` or `leafOptionId` should be set.

leafOptionId.description: Id of the final option this answer resolves to, ending the run. Exactly one of `nextQuestionId` or `leafOptionId` should be set.

SequentialAnswerChoice.description: One answer choice for a question in a sequential tree.

id.description: Unique id for this option. Referenced by answer choices via `leafOptionId` (sequential) or as a key in `scores` (weighted).

name.description: Display name of this outcome, e.g. "Apache Spark Job".

description.description: Optional longer description shown on the result screen.

FinalOption.description: One possible final outcome of the tree.

id.description: Unique id for this question, matching its key in the parent `questions` map.

text.description: The question text shown to the person answering.

choices.description: The answer choices for this question. At least 2 are required.

WeightedQuestion.description: A single question in a weighted tree; its choices each carry point scores.

text.description: The answer text shown as a radio option.

scores.description: Points this answer contributes to each final option, keyed by option id. A missing key counts as 0.

WeightedAnswerChoice.description: One answer choice for a question in a weighted tree.
